protocol.description: Final declared comparison after the separately retained development pilot. Same brickwork generator and seeds as the original stress test. Exact product-observer return plus exact dyadic MPS boundary contraction. Failed rows retained.
protocol.timing: Sequential fresh isolated single-thread processes. Execution excludes imports and construction; includes cold suffix tables and selected readout. No term or SVD truncation. Peak RSS includes setup. One run per row.
